1. Make the action queue durable and concurrency-safe. A single JSON file is overwritten for every Continue request, so requests can be lost; a worker crash can also leave an action permanently `processing`. Use uniquely identified jobs, atomic writes/locking (or SQLite), and recovery/timeouts.
